worker_claim.report: Updated runtime admission/receipt handling, cleanup status projection and IPC decoding, plus a regression assertion that dry-run inventory does not create mutable receipts. Focused workspace/IPC tests and lint pass.
worker_claim.summary: Separated workspace cleanup dry-runs from mutable admission and persistence, while retaining service-owner serialization. Apply requests now persist completed bounded results for replay and re-observe admitted-but-incomplete requests; cleanup outcomes are exposed through durable status projection, and post-publication cleanup catches only expected workspace/Git refusal classes.
